after: We introduce Chinese-SkillSpan, a benchmark for competency span extraction in Chinese job advertisements. Built from a corpus of 22,840 sentences across four recruitment collections, it combines annotation guidelines, distinct supervision and reference subsets, scoring protocols, and model baselines. The handbook distinguishes language (L), knowledge (K), occupational skills (S), and transversal competences (T).
